'''Briton Ferry Llansawel A.F.C.''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed Llansawel}}<ref>https://sgorio.cymru/cymru-premier/</ref>) is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Briton Ferry]] in [[Wales]], currently playing in the {{Welsh football updater|BritonF}}. The club was formed in 2009 after the merger between [[Briton Ferry Athletic F.C.|Briton Ferry Athletic]] and [[Llansawel F.C.|Llansawel]].

The club's crest uses the colours green, red and yellow, which represent the colours of the two merged teams. For 2009–10 the home colours were the traditional Briton Ferry quartered red and green shirt, green shorts and red socks. The away colours were the traditional Llansawel yellow shirt, black shorts and hooped yellow and black socks.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.welshleague.org.uk/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090224211319/http://www.welshleague.org.uk/sub_page3.htm|url-status=dead|title=Home Page|archivedate=24 February 2009|website=www.welshleague.org.uk}}</ref>"}}
